chose: A terminal card types its commands as a new design of the one card, terminal-v2, pinned by a new cheat-sheet version (v6 = v5 with terminal-v2), never by a per-line flag or a per-video switch. A line with a prompt shows the prompt, then types its keyword and text a character every 45 ms (about 22 a second) behind a steady block cursor that doesn't blink, then shows its comment; the next line waits until it is typed plus 350 ms, so a command's output never shows before the command. A line with no prompt (output, a comment) appears as in v1.
options: a new design, terminal-v2, pinned by a series version
gray: The owner asked for commands typed with the typewriter effect (#3476) and named no speed, cursor or what output does. Each is seen in every essay that pins v6, and a design is frozen once a published video uses it, so changing one later means another design.
undo: Pin cheat-sheet v5 (or a later version naming terminal-v1) in the essay; to change the look, add terminal-v3 and a series version naming it. terminal-v2 itself stays as drawn once a published video pins v6.
